newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up on technical rebound.

text.p: Shanghai B shares closed up on a technical rebound on Tuesday after sharp losses in the past weeks but further rises will be limited, brokers said.
The index rose 0.647 points or 1.44 percent to 45.514 points, on volume of 7.6 million shares worth $2.5 million. Of 41 B shares, 36 traded, with 20 up, nine flat and seven down.

Brokers said market barometer Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development led the rebound helped by news that a local bank would provide it with loans totalling one billion yuan over the next three years to finance projects in Lujiazui.
Shanghai Lujiazui rose $0.040 or 5.12 percent to $0.820 on volume of 375,500 shares.
"Some individual bargain-hunting emerged late in the session, which helped push the index up," one broker said. "But their motive is to seek quick profits with speculation."
"Further rises will be limited, with liquidation expected from overseas and domestic institutions," another broker said.
China Textile Machinery was the star on speculative buying ahead of the close, jumping $0.010 or 10.20 percent to $0.108, on volume of 13,000 shares.
Shanghai Post & Communication Equipment traded most on overseas institutional selling and became the second biggest loser, down $0.012 or 4.44 percent to $0.258, on volume of 2.5 million shares.
Shanghai A shares closed up on cautious buying but the market will not rise sharply with the approach of the end of the year, brokers said.

The A index closed up 9.413 points or 0.96 percent at 993.072 points, on volume of 435.7 million shares worth 3.6 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index rose 27.322 points or 1.12 percent to 2458.549 points.
Ningbo Fuda was the star on speculative buying, jumping 1.44 yuan or 11.07 percent to 14.44 yuan, on volume of 1.3 million shares.
